fixes.fix: Explained "The election saw a landslide victory for the _____ébec (CAQ) led by François Legault, whic"
fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: The answer is Coalition Avenir Québec. 2) WHY: François Legault’s CAQ secured 74 of 125 seats, a landslide that ousted the Quebec Liberal Party. 3) TRAPS: Do not confuse this with the Parti Québécois or Bloc Québécois; the specific seat count and leader name uniquely identify CAQ. 4) HOOK: Remember '74 seats, Legault lead' to lock in the party name. Exam trap: Candidates often mix up Quebec’s major parties, so always match the leader’s name to the correct acronym.

fixes.fix: Explained "It was also the first since _____ that had been won by a party other than the Liberals or "
fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: The correct answer is 1966. 2) WHY: This marks the end of a long era where only the Liberals or Parti Québécois dominated federal politics. 3) TRAPS: Do not confuse this with provincial elections or misremember the start of the PC era. 4) HOOK: Think of 1966 as the 'last Liberal holdout' before the political landscape shifted. Exam trap: Verify if the question asks about federal or provincial context, as PQ dominance varies by region.
